entities.name: Ouallada
entities.description: Speaker of a threatening line about visiting when darkness comes.

entities.name: Arcum Dagsson
entities.description: A Soldevi machinist who advises knowing one's foes' strengths and weaknesses.

entities.name: Shivan dragon
entities.description: Dragons that are cruel and take particular glee in tormenting their victims.

entities.name: Hurloon Minotaurs
entities.description: Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains, known for their love of battle and for hymns to the dead.

entities.name: Hurloon Mountains
entities.description: Mountains where the minotaurs dwell, filled with their haunting hymns.

events.summary: Ouallada warns that a visit will come when darkness falls, on the best night for hiding.
events.quote: Expect my visit when the darkness comes.

events.summary: Arcum Dagsson advises knowing foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses.
events.quote: Know your foes' strengths as well as their weaknesses.

events.summary: Hurloon minotaurs sing hymns to the dead for friend and foe alike, lasting for days.
events.quote: They are also known for their hymns to the dead, sung for friend and foe alike.

relations.note: The minotaurs live in the Hurloon Mountains.
relations.quote: The Minotaurs of the Hurloon Mountains are known for their love of battle.
